message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads data only from local CSV files via pandas (pd.read_csv) with no remote source fetching, and no checksum verification or authentication mechanisms are present.
No detected label flipping detection: No code validates label distributions, checks labels against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation path contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples to guard against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models and data via pickle and file paths without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity of loaded artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (MSE, MAE, R2, classification_report, confusion_matrix) are computed, there is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data via cryptographic signing/hashing, nor any mechanism to prevent metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code only performs type coercions for hyperparameters (clean_up_net_params) and loads CSV data without any shape, range, or schema validation on inference inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model predictions are visible in the truncated code; there are no NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validations applied to inference outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses sklearn/Keras regression and classification models, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
